[Support & Resistance Structure]

· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low) — Recovery signal, exploring potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.21x) — Moderate strength in price movement, average reliability.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — RSI exited oversold and MACD shows improvement, meeting conditions for buy-side wait-and-see pending further confirmation.
